items.html:
An aggressive left-handed batsman who likens his style of play to Chris Gayle, John Campbell won a berth in the West Indies squad for the Under-19 World Cup in New Zealand in 2010. He was a member of the triumphant Jamaica Under-19 team in the regional championships.
Cricinfo Staff, January 2010
